The shelf used to name a publication's source when more than one was configured; this change's whole premise is one library, so nothing on the shelf states which source a publication came from. And scoping is replaced by filtering: the delta says in as many words that a source is offered 'as a filter … and not as a scope the view is in', which is why 'the scope persists until changed' cannot be carried - there is no scope left to persist. Kavita connection.reason: Removed because nothing can perform it. The version came from GET /api/Server/server-info, which is absent from Kavita's published openapi.json at v0.8.6, v0.8.8, v0.8.9.1, v0.9.0 and v0.9.1.4, and answers 404 on a live 0.9.1.4. No other route states the version to a reader's API key: Server/version, Health/api-version and Server/accepting-connections are absent from all five, Server/server-info-slim needs an administrator, and Health answers Ok with no version in it. The verbs of every route either client calls are identical across those five releases, so a floor would refuse nobody. The delta replaces the bullet with requirement prose that forbids the question and states what took its place: an unknown route raises the "too old" sentence at the request that failed. Drains when no-version-to-ask-a-kavita-for syncs.

Unified library.reason: The same three bullets one-library-three-destinations drops, for the same reasons, and dropped here only because both changes now carry one identical block. `delta-drop` found the two blocks differing: whichever synced second would have deleted the other's scenarios. They were merged into their union and written word for word into both files, so the order they sync in no longer matters -- which is the safer fix, because an order recorded under `collisions` still relies on someone honouring it. The union inherits this change's five additions (every kind of source contributes, browsing is a second way in, a source never reached, a publication also downloaded, a partial count) on top of one-library's origin-invisible clause and availability axis, and it inherits these three deliberate removals with them.
